messages:
maya: Heads-up — prepping the Tue change window for runtime v2.13 (planned 2026-04-05, 18:00 PT). I have a short release notes draft and internal announce copy. Need ops + comms signoff and a decision on pin/canary lanes.

sam: Can you paste the short internal blurb here? I will sanity-check with comms and schedule the post.

maya: Draft blurb: 'Runtime v2.13 rolling Tue 18:00 PT. Improvements: reduced median latency for short sequences, smarter batching heuristics, and safer OOM fallback behavior. No public API changes. Ops will monitor latency and error rates; rollback criteria below.' Thoughts?

devon: Looks clear. Add rollback thresholds so comms knows expectations: 'Rollback if 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency regress > 150ms vs baseline for 5m.'

jess: +1. Ops: do we have a pinned prod image for immediate rollback to 2.12.8? Who will own the rollback command? @ops-oncall

ops-oncall: We have 2.12.8 image in prod registry ready. Rollback runbook is updated (link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/runtime-rollback). Ownership: ops-oncall will trigger rollback; devon and maya will assist for troubleshooting. Reserve ~15m to complete rollback if needed.

maya: OK adding to the blurb: 'Rollback plan: immediate revert to 2.12.8 if thresholds hit; ops-oncall to execute; dev leads on standby.' Also need note for Dedicated customers about pinning.

lin: Please include an explicit line: 'Dedicated customers remain on their current pinned runtime (2.12.x) unless they opt-in to 2.13 via support ticket.' We had a similar customer question last release.

maya: Good call. Revised comms copy: 'Teams — we will deploy runtime v2.13 Tue 18:00 PT (internal). Expect transient routing adjustments. No API changes. Ops will monitor p95 latency and 5xx rate; rollback to 2.12.8 if thresholds exceeded. Dedicated customers are not upgraded automatically.'

sam: Nice. I'll add a one-sentence TL;DR for the internal announce and schedule at Tue 16:30 PT so teams see it ~1.5h before window.

maya: Canary plan: start with 10% traffic for 15m, then 50% for 20m if healthy, then full. Deploybot config snippet:

```yaml
canary:
  - percent: 10
    duration: 15m
  - percent: 50
    duration: 20m
  - percent: 100
    duration: 10m
metrics:
  - name: p95_latency_ms
    threshold: 150
  - name: error_rate_5xx
    threshold: 0.005
```

deploybot: deploybot: Canary run queued by maya. Starting sequence at Tue 18:00 PT. Canary stages are 10%/50%/100%. Link to run: https://deploybot.redwood/deploys/17521

deploybot: deploybot: Canary started — 10% traffic. Will post status updates every 5m.

jess: Ops, please confirm monitoring dashboards and alerting are set to the thresholds above and that runbook links are attached to the deploybot messages.

ops-oncall: Confirmed. Dashboards: runtime/p95 and infra/5xx error-rate set. Alerts: paged at threshold breach. Runbook attached to deploybot annotations. I'll be on-call for the window.

devon: I'll be watching model-serving logs and the KV cache metrics. If we see cache pressure or any correctness regressions, I'll recommend immediate rollback.

sam: Comms final: 'Internal: runtime v2.13 rollout Tue 18:00 PT. Expect brief routing changes; no API changes. Ops monitoring p95 and 5xx. Rollback plan in place; Dedicated customers unaffected unless opted in. Contact #eng-oncall for incidents.' I'll post at 16:30 PT.

jess: I'll also prepare a short pinned note in the release channel with runbook links and the rollback checklist so folks can act quickly.

maya: Thanks all. Final checklist: confirm deploybot link in announcement (sam), ops-oncall on-call (ops-oncall), rollback image available (ops-oncall), dev leads on standby (devon, maya). If no objections I'll schedule announce now.

sam: No objections from comms. Posting at 16:30 PT. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: I'll ack in the channel when I go into monitoring mode 15m before rollout.

maya: Great — closing thread. Will follow up post-canary with a short status update.
